findings.reason: the node judging "at most 24" against the committed 30 cannot tell which set the ceiling was drawn from, so the sentence that grounds the bar has to name that set (or cite where the 24 were listed) before the node runs.
findings.text: bullet 4 fixes the undecided bound as "at most 24, the bound the lead set on 2026-11-12 after reading the 24 listed families", but no committed artifact lists 24 families: the only listing, `docs/evidence/fragments/sn-domain-per-family/labelled-comparison.json`, carries 42 undecided families, 30 of them with two or more members (`undecided_summary`), so the bound's stated provenance cannot be reconciled with the record it points at

findings.reason: §3's node is sent to buy a ruling it has already been given, and its gate reports the plan's own held-split outcome as failure, so the two sections must state one rule for a below-floor family.
findings.text: bullet 4 says the families below the floor "are held split with each member decided on its own sources, so §3 is not left to settle the catalog one ruling at a time", while §3 (plan.html:67) still has the coordinator bring each such family to the lead and record "a correction naming the family", and §3's first done-when excuses a split family only when it is covered by "a recorded lead correction that names the family"; under the lead's standing ruling those held-split families are excused by nothing §3 recognises, so §3's read-back would count up to 24 correctly held families as failures
